mentions.name: gargoyle
mentions.description: An ActivityPub server with a theoretically Mastodon-compatible UI, tested with BookWyrm, Lemmy, Mastodon and GTS, aiming for a pretty UI and an open, broadly federated fediverse.
mentions.problem: Annoyance at homogeneous fediverse dev teams that don't want their services to federate with others, and GTS being too hard to hack on.
mentions.source_excerpt: and gargoyle, an activitypub server with a (theoretically mastodon compatible UI) https://github.com/myfedi/gargoyle. Was annoyed at the homogenous fediverse dev teams out there that don't want their precious service federate with others.

mentions.name: gargoyle
mentions.description: An open ActivityPub/fediverse server built as a GoToSocial alternative, designed with an emphasis on interoperability, hackability, and openness.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've started working on a gotosocial alternative (activitypub/fediverse server) that's a bit more geared towards interoperability, hackability, and openness. Also submitted an NLNet funding request, fingers crossed!

https://github.com/myfedi/gargoyle
